name: Base path and JAX-RS application
designer: MUST prefix every call with `/api/v1`; SHOULD read `Environment.latestApiVersion` (SRV-014) to detect newer API versions.

name: GET /api/v1/component/index
designer: MUST call it to build the palette; SHOULD pass the user language and cache the answer until `Environment.lastUpdated` changes.

name: GET /api/v1/component/details
designer: MUST fetch details before rendering a form or creating a job node; MUST persist `ComponentDetail.version` with the configuration (see SRV-004).
runtime: none; the runtime obtains the same information from `ComponentManager` metadata.

name: POST /api/v1/component/migrate/{id}/{configurationVersion}
designer: MUST call it on load when the stored version is lower than `ComponentDetail.version`, then persist the returned map with the new version.
runtime: MUST perform the same migration through `ComponentManager` when it receives an older version (see RUN/LCM categories).

name: Icon endpoints
designer: SHOULD render icons from these endpoints or from `includeIconContent=true`; MUST handle 404 with a default icon.

name: GET /api/v1/component/dependencies
designer: MAY use it to package a job.
runtime: A runtime that does not have plugins locally MAY use it with SRV-007 to download them; otherwise none.

name: GET /api/v1/component/dependency/{id}
designer: MAY proxy it.
runtime: MAY download artifacts with it after SRV-006.

name: GET /api/v1/documentation/component/{id}
designer: SHOULD display it in a help panel and render asciidoc (or use the returned rendering).

name: GET /api/v1/configurationtype/index
designer: MUST use it to offer reusable datastores/datasets and to link them to components.

name: GET /api/v1/configurationtype/details
designer: MUST use it to render dataset/datastore forms.

name: POST /api/v1/configurationtype/migrate/{id}/{configurationVersion}
designer: MUST migrate stored datasets/datastores whose version is older.
runtime: SHOULD migrate through `ComponentManager` for nested dataset versions.

name: GET /api/v1/action/index
designer: MAY use it for discovery; component details already carry action references. MUST use the `ActionReference` entries of the component/config detail to resolve triggers; MAY use the index for custom (`user`, ACT-001) actions.

name: POST /api/v1/action/execute
designer: MUST send only the properties the action declares (see the action's `properties` from `ComponentDetail`), with the exact `configuration.<path>` keys; MUST interpret errors by status and `ErrorPayload.code`. MUST send only the parameters listed in the trigger `parameters` (key = action parameter path, value = form value at `path`); MUST map HTTP `400`/`456`/`520` to user-visible errors using `ErrorPayload.description` (MAY distinguish user vs backend errors); SHOULD debounce change-triggered calls and drop stale responses (inferred).

name: GET /api/v1/environment
designer: SHOULD poll it (or call on reconnect) to invalidate its component cache when `lastUpdated`/`connectors.pluginsHash` change; MUST tolerate 404.

name: POST /api/v1/bulk
designer: MAY use it to reduce round trips (index + details).

name: GET /api/v1/cache/clear
designer: MAY expose a "reload components" action (Studio dev mode does).

name: Response caching and invalidation
designer: MUST NOT rely on `ETag`/`304`; SHOULD cache responses client-side keyed by URL + language and invalidate when `Environment.lastUpdated`/`connectors.pluginsHash` changes.

name: Internationalization (language parameter and locale mapping)
designer: MUST send the UI language in `language`/`lang`; SHOULD accept that the returned language may differ (fallback `en`).

name: Security handlers (connection and command)
designer: MUST add authentication in front of the server (gateway/handler) in multi-tenant deployments; MAY forward `x-talend-tenant-id` (SRV-020).

name: Credential decryption (vault)
designer: MAY send encrypted (`vault:`-prefixed) credentials to action calls instead of clear text; MUST send the tenant header when the deployment is multi-tenant.
runtime: SHOULD decrypt `vault:` values before instantiating components if it stores them encrypted (unverified: runtime-side handling is host-specific).

name: Documentation UI and toggle
designer: none

name: Simple query language (q parameter)
designer: MAY use it for server-side palette filtering; MUST escape spaces properly in URLs.

name: Server configuration keys (summary)
designer: none beyond knowing which endpoints may be disabled (`environment`, `documentation`).

name: Error payload (ErrorPayload and ErrorDictionary)
designer: MUST parse `ErrorPayload` on non-2xx and surface `description`; MUST distinguish 4xx user errors, 456 backend errors and 520 unexpected errors from actions.

name: Plugin deployment, registry and reloading
designer: MUST refresh its palette after `lastUpdated` changes (SRV-014).
